title: Pipe chart scales to fit any run length
description:
The pipe chart now dynamically fits every observation, even on long runs with many codes. The observation code tags shrink automatically so they never overlap or get cut off, and the whole chart stays clean and readable at any panel size. Pipe marks stay pinned to their true chainage, so positions remain exactly correct.

Who is affected: everyone on the private server, and on SaaS after Push.
changeLog: Pipe chart observation tags auto-scale to fit long runs without overlap or clipping.
Code tags shrink as needed based on observation count and available height.
Pipe marks remain locked to true chainage, so positions stay accurate.
Chart re-fits automatically when the pipe panel is resized.
